summary:
A Qualified Chartered Accountant with strong academic background and excellent analytical and communication skills. Eager to
contribute to a forward-looking organization with a solutions-oriented mindset. Committed to applying knowledge effectively and
driving sustainable growth while evolving as a professional.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(MS-Office→MS Office(100%), Problem-solving→Problem Solving(100%), Interpersonal-skills→Interpersonal Skills(97%))

bullets: Executed detailed audit testing procedures for revenue streams, payroll systems, SG&A expenses, and cost of sales.
Performed testing of accounts receivable/payable, inventory cutoff procedures, and cash reconciliations, to ensure completeness and accuracy.
Executed Audit data analytics for lease, payroll and JE procedures using BDO Harmony.
Prepared related party and debt confirmations using the APT platform.
Performed Sampling based on internal information, SURL testing, and contributed to final analytical review procedures.
Prepared Audit workpapers for various EMEIA based Entities.
Performed Test of Details (TOD) tasks for various entities including the formalization of invoices and other relevant documents.
Performed of Substantive Analytical Procedures for various line items of the financial statements (e.g.
Interest Income & Expense and Depreciation & Amortization) and Validation of Financial Statements for various entities.
Utilized advanced data analytics techniques to support audit enablement tasks, providing insights for offshore audit teams.
Conducted concurrent audits for international banks and statutory audits for a reputed PSU bank, adhering to RBI regulations.
Prepared accounts up to finalization and conducted GST audit reconciliations and ensured compliance with tax regulations.
Performed vouching, verification, and reconciliations for private limited entities.
Filed income tax returns for individuals and corporate entities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with tax laws.
Conducted inventory verification of Specified Bank Notes at currency chest.
Participated in audit discussions and liaised with tax and GST departments.
